notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.
